    struct AlbedoDetail
    Detail below a map's resolution: fractal noise that continues the map's own measured roughness to finer scales, multiplying the albedo.
    class AlbedoLayer
    A change to an albedo: bright ejecta around fresh craters, or a layer of your own.
    class AlbedoSource
    Where an albedo starts: a map from orbit, a synthetic color, or a source of your own.
    class AnchoredPlane
    The plane a layer lays its features out in: the surface itself on a plane, or on a body the tangent frame of anchor , true to scale near it and empty on the far hemisphere.
    struct BackendStatus
    Whether a backend can run here, on which device, or why not.
    class BandBuckets
    Indices bucketed per size band into cubes of a side set per band ( Surface::Bucket ), each bucket holding its indices in the order added.
    struct BandScaling
    A band's scale and offset: a sample s stands fors * scale + offset , as GDAL's band SCALE and OFFSET metadata say.
    struct BaseRoughness
    Self-affine roughness: the RMS height difference at a lag L is nu(L) = deviation (L /cellSize )^H, so the RMS slope over a baseline b is nu(b) / b = s(c) (b / c)^(H - 1) (Shepard et al.
    class BedformLayer
    Fields of wind-blown bedforms, ripples or dunes, added to the terrain.
    struct BedformOptions
    The bedform fields a BedformLayer scatters: their ripples, cover and wind.
    struct BindsNativeTrait <typename IO, typename>
    Whether IO declaresstatic constexpr bool kBindsNative = true .
    struct BindsNativeTrait< IO, std::enable_if_t< IO::kBindsNative > > <typename IO>
    struct BlastZone
    The blast zone around one lander (Clegg et al.
    class BlastZoneAlbedo
    Blast zones around landers, changing the albedo by the relative reflectance they give; the same in any grid, tile or point.
    struct Boulder
    One boulder: where it stands, how large it is and how it lies, in surface coordinates and meters.
    struct BoulderAbundance
    How rich the boulders are at a point.
    struct BoulderBackground
    The models of a layer's abundance between craters, each built once from valid options.
    struct BoulderBedrock
    Boulders breaking out of bedrock: abundance scales from 1 on soil to abundance on bedrock, in proportion to the exposure.
    struct BoulderClusters
    Boulders between craters gathered in clusters: share of them crowd within aboutradius of cluster centers aboutspacing apart and the rest stay scattered.
    struct BoulderEjecta
    Blocks thrown out by craters that dug through the regolith, added to the boulders between craters: densest at the rim, thinning outward and with age; overlapping ejecta take the largest share.
    struct BoulderFacet
    A plane that sand-laden wind has cut across a boulder's windward side: a ventifact facet.
    struct BoulderFeatures
    Boulders, and those of them placed as their own 3D models.
    struct BoulderFillet
    Regolith piled against each boulder's base, drawn into the heights around boulders drawn there and around boulder models alike: it meets the boulder's flank where the rock stands heightShare of the exposed height (FilletContact ), then falls as (1 - t)^2 to nothingwidthRatio diameters beyond the boulder's radius.
    struct BoulderFragment
    One piece of a split boulder shape.
    struct BoulderFragmentation
    Boulders broken by wear into pieces that replace them.
    class BoulderLayer
    Boulders scattered over the ground, in patches and richer on bedrock, plus blocks around fresh craters; they depend only on position, so every grid, tile and point agrees.
    struct BoulderLayerOptions
    How a BoulderLayer sizes, places, poses and draws its boulders.
    class BoulderList
    Boulders stored as one array per field, as CraterList stores craters, so each column can be shared with NumPy or a GPU without copying.
    class BoulderMapAbundance
    How a density map sets a boulder layer's abundance between craters: the abundance at which the boulder sizes measure what the map does, once the crater blocks there are taken out of it for a total map.
    struct BoulderModel
    A boulder placed as a 3D model of its own.
    struct BoulderModelThreshold
    Which boulders become 3D models of their own: those at or above either lower threshold and below every upper one set; no lower threshold means no models.
    struct BoulderPatches
    Patches of richer and poorer boulder cover.
    struct BoulderPlacement
    How a unit BoulderShape becomes a boulder in the world: scaled per axis byscale , then moved bypose .
    class BoulderPlacer
    A layer that places boulders.
    struct BoulderPose
    How each boulder stands, drawn per boulder uniformly between these.
    struct BoulderReliefRange
    Which boulders are drawn into the heights: those from minDiameter up tomaxDiameter that are not models, and models too withmodels .
    struct BoulderRendering
    How boulders are drawn: as relief in the heights or as 3D models, and with which shapes.
    struct BoulderShape
    A boulder's shape in unit form, with the origin inside it.
    struct BoulderShapeOptions
    Settings for GenerateBoulderShape .
    struct BoulderSizes
    The sizes of the boulders between craters: distribution , or Golombek and Rapp (1997) boulders ofcoverage without one, fromminDiameter up tomaxDiameter .
    struct BoulderStyle
    One kind of boulder: the solid it starts from and the ranges its shape is drawn from.
    struct BoulderVentifacts
    Ventifacts: windward facets planed on boulders by sand-laden wind, set once the boulder has settled.
    struct Bounds2d
    An axis-aligned box [ minX ,maxX ) x [minY ,maxY ) in surface coordinates (meters on a plane, the world coordinates a raster'sGeoTransform maps pixels to).
    struct Box3d
    An axis-aligned box.
    struct BucketIndex
    The integer coordinates of a cube of a 3D grid.
    struct BuildInfo
    Build metadata captured when the linked library was last rebuilt (see cmake/BuildInfo.cmake); it describes the linked libraries, not the headers compiled against.
    struct BuildMeshOptions
    What a BuildMesh leaves out and hangs below its edges.
    struct CellCraters
    The craters of one cell in the order drawn, with their indices ordered by y so the craters of a row range are found by binary search.
    struct CellIndex
    Integer coordinates of one cell in a grid of square cells.
    struct CellPosition
    A kernel's position: a cell center or point measured from the layer's origin, in meters, so single precision stays accurate far from the frame's origin.
    struct ChainSeams
    How a SourceChain joins each source to the gaps of those before it.
    class ClampLayer
    Clamps the heights so far to [ min ,max ], either bound optional.
    class ComplexCraterProfile
    Simple craters below a transition diameter, complex ones from it: a flat floor, a concave wall, a central peak lowered as the crater wears, and a power-law exterior.
    struct ComplexCraterShape
    The flat floor and central peak of complex craters on a body, from the diameter they start at; depth and rim height come from the crater's state.
    class ConfigError
    A problem with a configuration, located by the JSON path of the offending value, such as "layers[1].density.age_gyr" or "layers[0].stack[1].octaves".
    struct ConfigSummary
    What a valid configuration generates, as ValidateConfig finds it.
    class ConstantField
    The same value everywhere.
    struct Crater
    One crater: center in surface coordinates, rim-to-rim diameter, age and a stable ID, and for a manual crater optionally its depth and rim height.
    class CraterAgeModel
    Assigns ages to craters by diameter, within a visible lifetime per diameter.
    class CraterAlbedo
    The bright ejecta, interiors and rays of the craters of a CraterLayer , asCraterAlbedoOptions describes, shaped by the craters' irregular outlines where the layer has them.
    struct CraterAlbedoOptions
    The bright material of fresh craters, in optical maturity (OMAT) over the background's: an interior excess, ejecta falling as a power of distance, and rays.
    struct CraterAlbedoTexture
    The texture of fresh craters' bright material, keyed to each crater and off by default: radial streaks breaking ejecta, rays, interiors and the bright proximal reflectance zone into filaments, a lobed ejecta edge, and walls brighter than floors.
    struct CraterApplyOptions
    How ApplyCraters shapes craters into the terrain.
    struct CraterAttributes
    What a crater looks like in its current state, for listing, labeling or placing.
    struct CraterBand
    A size band of crater generation: diameters [ low ,high ) meters, from 2^exponent to 2^(exponent + 1) clipped to the requested range.
    struct CraterBin
    The craters listed in one diameter bin [ minDiameter ,maxDiameter ) and the count a target size-frequency distribution expects there.
    struct CraterBlend
    Where a crater's replaced interior blends into the surrounding terrain, in crater radii.
    struct CraterBodyDatumKernel
    What fitting crater datums on a body takes on the GPU: the craters' shapes.
    struct CraterData
    Where the variable-length values of craters are read from.
    struct CraterDatumKernel
    What fitting crater datums takes: the craters' shapes, the fit footprint and the lattice the ground is sampled on ( FitCraterDatum ), and the size bands that index the craters.
    struct CraterFeatures
    Craters and their attributes, in step.
    struct CraterFrame
    A crater's local frame on a body, from which the GPU works out each sample's offset ( KernelFrameOffset ) asSurface::Offset does.
    struct CraterGenerationOptions
    Which craters GenerateCraters draws, and how.
    struct CraterImpact
    The impact that formed a crater, as ObliqueImpacts draws it.
    struct CraterIrregularity
    Which craters have irregular outlines and the distributions their shapes are drawn from, per crater from its ID.
    class CraterLayer
    Craters generated over the grid being evaluated ( GenerateCraters ) and applied to it (ApplyCraters ) at the evaluation's spacing.
    struct CraterLayerOptions
    How a CraterLayer generates and applies its craters.
    class CraterList
    Craters stored as one array per field, so each column can be shared with NumPy or a GPU without copying.
    struct CraterModels
    The models a crater layer generates and shapes craters with.
    struct CraterMorphometry
    A crater's shape measures relative to its diameter.
    struct CraterNoise
    Fractal noise added to each crater, keyed to its ID so tiles and point queries agree: over the whole footprint, fading out to nothing at the profile's reach, and in a band around the rim.
    struct CraterOutline
    One crater's outline: the factor its rim radius and profile are stretched by in each direction.
    struct CraterPeaks
    Central peaks of complex craters built from massifs drawn per crater ID in place of the round dome, at the profile's peak height and base; only closed-form ComplexCraterProfile s use them.
    class CraterPlacer
    A layer that places craters.
    class CraterProfile
    The topography of a crater: height relative to the pre-impact surface by distance from the center, for a degradation state.
    struct CraterProfileKernel
    A crater profile as the kernel evaluates it: a simple profile, complex craters from a transition diameter ( ComplexCraterProfile ), and diffusion of the fresh shape by tables (DiffusedProfile ).
    struct CraterRays
    The rays of a crater: narrow streaks of immature material running out from the rim, after Elliott et al.
    struct CraterRecord
    One crater ready to shape.
    struct CraterReflectanceZones
    The four reflectance zones around new small craters in LROC temporal pairs (Robinson et al.
    struct CraterReplacement
    How craters with Crater::replace replace the terrain beneath them: in full out tostartRadii , blending to none atendRadii , cut into a plane fitted to the ground on a ring fromendRadii out toendRadii +fitWidthRadii , so neither the crater replaced nor its rim pulls the datum, whatever datum the other craters have.
    struct CraterSampling
    How ApplyCraters samples a raster or points.
    struct CraterSelection
    Which craters a model applies to, by diameter, age and whether manual.
    struct CraterShapeKernel
    How craters are shaped, as CraterApplyOptions and the profile give it.
    struct CraterShapeModels
    The models craters are shaped with: their profile and the degradation state it is drawn in.
    struct CraterSlopeResponse
    How craters formed on a slope become asymmetric along it and wear faster, after Plescia et al.
    struct CraterSlopeShape
    One crater's asymmetry on its slope.
    struct CraterSpacing
    Keeps craters of similar size apart: two conflict when their diameters differ by at most diameterRatio and their centers are closer thanseparation times the larger diameter.
    struct CraterState
    A crater's degradation state: its morphometry when fresh and now.
    struct CraterTerraces
    Slump terraces on the walls of large craters, benches and scarps drawn per crater ID that soften as it wears; the floor edge is the profile's, else Pike's (1980, USGS PP 1046-C, eq.
    struct CraterTexture
    The texture of a crater's walls and ejecta, keyed to its ID: radial gullies down the inner wall, hummocky ejecta lineated away from the rim, and older relief buried under the ejecta.
    class CubeSphereCells
    Near-square cells on a body, in longitude and latitude degrees: each face of a cube split into n x n cells along equiangular coordinates of the direction from the center.
    class DegradationModel
    Maps each crater to its degradation state, from its diameter and age.
    struct DensityMap
    A map of a crater or boulder population that sets a layer's density point by point: the size distribution keeps its shape and is scaled to measure what the map does, and applies as given where the map has no value.
    class DensityScale
    The local scale a density map gives a size distribution: the map's value over its measure of the distribution, 1 where the map has no value.
    struct DeviogramFit
    A least-squares line through log2 of a height difference statistic over log2 lag in cells.
    struct DiameterRange
    Diameters in meters where a distribution is defined: ( min ,max ], or withmin = 0 all positive diameters up tomax .
    struct DiamondSquareOptions
    The fractal a DiamondSquareUpsampler refines posts with.
    class DiamondSquareUpsampler
    Random midpoint displacement of a source's posts (Martin, Parkes and Dunstan 2014; Peitgen and Saupe 1988): each level halves the node spacing and displaces new nodes by a Gaussian that shrinks by 2^-((3 - F) / 2) per step, keyed by node and level so grids, tiles and points agree.
    class DiffusedProfile
    A fresh crater profile worn by topographic diffusion, tabulated in the diffusion age tau = kappa t / D^2 from 1e-5 to 0.5; older craters keep the last shape.
    class DiffusionDegradation
    Craters worn by topographic diffusion, shaped with its DiffusedProfile .
    struct DuneGrainflows
    Grainflows on slip faces: avalanches that leave a theater-headed scarp below the brink and a tongue-shaped lobe of sand below it.
    class DuneLayer
    Wind-blown dunes added to the terrain, barchan crescents or crest-line dunes with slip faces at slipFaceAngle ; overlapping dunes join as their upper envelope.
    struct DuneOptions
    The dunes a DuneLayer builds, their sizes and slopes.
    struct DuneRipples
    Ripples superposed on dunes, their crests bent by the dune's slope: each rises along a straight stoss to a sharp crest and falls along a straight lee.
    class EjectaIndex
    Craters bucketed by the discs their ejecta reach ( BandBuckets , one band per power of two of reach), so the craters able to reach a point are found without visiting all of them.

    struct EquilibriumSurface
    A surface ageGyr old bychronology , cratered byproduction and capped by theequilibrium density: its crater density and steady-state ages from the one set of models, so they cannot disagree.
    class EvaluationCache
    Thread-safe values that depend only on the terrain beneath a layer, such as crater datums, shared by point queries; use one cache per generator and renew it after changing its layers.
    struct EvaluationOptions
    How to evaluate a terrain over a grid.
    class ExposureField
    How far the ground at a point is bedrock rather than soil, from its shape alone.
    struct ExposureParams
    The thresholds an ExposureField tells soil from bedrock by; a rule of thumb, not a measurement.
    class FassettThomsonProfile
    Fresh simple-crater profile of Fassett and Thomson (2014, eq.
    struct FeatureCell
    One cell ForEachFeatureCell visits.
    struct FieldRange
    What a field accepts on its own: the values a number, or each number of a list, may take, how many items a list holds, and whether it must be given.
    class FieldRangeError
    A value outside the range its field declares, at the field's path, such as "ripples.wavelength_m: must be positive, got 0".
    struct FilletContact
    Where a fillet meets its boulder along one direction from the boulder's center: the rock's outermost point there as high as the fillet stands, heightShare of the boulder's exposed height, or the rock's highest point where it stands lower.
    class FlatSource
    A level datum at elevation over awidth xheight north-up grid of squarepixelSize cells centered oncenter : the start of a fully synthetic terrain.
    class FormulaLayer
    A layer whose height at a point depends only on the height there and the point (noise, roughness, transforms); the base applies HeightAt to every sample in parallel.
    struct Fractal
    One fractal of a stack: the FractalParams fields, an optional domain warp and a blend mode.
    struct FractalParams
    Parameters of a fractal built from octaves of a basis noise.
    struct FractalStack
    Up to kMaxFractals fractals in a fixed-size block, the form GPU kernels receive.
    class FreshAges
    Every crater is fresh: age and lifetime zero.
    class FreshnessAges
    Ages from a freshness f in [0, 1] drawn per crater: age = (1 - f) * lifetime, with one lifetime for every diameter, so RemainingLifetime gives back f.
    class FreshnessDegradation
    Scales fresh depth and rim height by e = c + (1 - c) * RemainingLifetime , with c making a crater at the end of its lifetime exactlycutoffDepthRatio deep; a crater already shallower than that when fresh, such as a large basin, keeps its fresh shape.
    class FunctionLayer
    A layer from a function of position, sample spacing and the height so far.
    struct GeneratedGrid
    What a configuration's outputs ask for over one grid, each computed once and shared by every output over the grid.
    struct GeneratedOutputs
    What a configuration's outputs ask for: its terrain, what each grid they cover holds and the whole body's mesh.
    struct GeoKeys
    A GeoTIFF's projection as raw GeoKey tags, written back unchanged.
    struct GeoTiff
    A raster read from a GeoTIFF with the projection keys to write it back with.
    class GeoTiffBlockReader
    One band of a GeoTIFF's first image read a block at a time from the file held open, a block being a tile or a strip spanning every column; blocks hold the samples ReadGeoTiff reads.
    class GeoTiffError
    A GeoTIFF that cannot be read or written, with the reason.
    struct GeoTiffInfo
    The layout and georeferencing of a GeoTIFF's first image.
    class GeoTiffSource
    Heights from one band of a GeoTIFF in a projected CRS, or in longitude and latitude (a geographic CRS) for a terrain on a body, served as a RasterSource serves its raster; samples take the band's scale and offset, orscale andoffset .
    struct GeoTiffSourceOptions
    How a GeoTiffSource reads its band.
    struct GeoTiffWriteOptions
    Settings for WriteGeoTiff .
    struct GeoTransform
    Affine mapping from pixel to world coordinates, as GDAL's six-coefficient geotransform.
    class GolombekRappSfd
    Boulder densities whose cumulative fractional area is F(D) = k exp(-q D), with q =qa +qb / k per meter and k the fraction of ground the boulders cover (coverage ); N(>=D) = (4 k q / pi) E2(q D) / D per m^2.
    struct GridReport
    Statistics of one evaluated grid; heights and slopes are over cells with data, NaN without any.
    class Ground
    The terrain beneath a layer (its source and the layers before it), readable anywhere.
    struct HapkeParameters
    The Hapke (1993) parameters of a surface, as fitted to Pancam photometry.
    struct HasEnumNames <typename E, typename>
    Whether EnumNames <E> is defined with itskValues .
    struct HasEnumNames< E, std::void_t< decltype(EnumNames< E >::kValues)> > <typename E>
    struct HasRangedFieldsTrait <typename T, typename>
    Whether Fields(checker, value) is callable with aRangeChecker .
    struct HasRangedFieldsTrait< T, std::void_t< decltype(Fields(std::declval< RangeChecker & >(), std::declval< T & >()))> > <typename T>
    struct IcqModel
    A shape model in Gaskell's implicitly connected quadrilateral (ICQ) format, in meters: one vertex per label (I, J, F) of the cube grid ( RadialShape::LabelDirection ), edge and corner vertices stored once per face as in the files.
    struct IdWords
    A 64-bit ID as two 32-bit words, for keying RandomStream andPhilox4x32 by it.
    struct InheritedCraters
    Craters a coarser level or a DEM catalog holds that the layer's source softens, stamped again sharp in place of what the source holds; generated craters they stand in for are dropped.
    struct KernelAgeRow
    The table row below a diffusion age and the weight of the row above it.
    struct KernelCellSpan
    The first and last cells of a band's row or column within one cell of position p .
    struct KernelOffset
    A point east and north of a crater's center, in meters, as the kernel reads it.
    class KernelOutline
    A crater's outline in the crater kernel's form, to read many points with.
    struct KernelPeakSize
    The height (m) and base radius (m) of a complex crater's fresh central peak.
    struct KernelPeriodicCell
    A periodic table's knot below an angle and the fraction of the way to the next.
    struct KernelProfilePoint
    A profile's height (m) and its slope over the radius at a point.
    struct KernelProgram
    A kernel compiled at build time by terraingen_add_kernel , once per GPU backend.
    struct KernelTableCell
    A table row's cell at a distance and the fraction of the way across it.
    class KernelUpsampler
    Interpolation of the posts with a kernel ( ResampleMethod ), at every spacing alike:Cubic , the default, gives the same bits asSampleRaster of the posts.
    struct KilometerPowerLaw
    y = coefficient * D^exponent with D and y in kilometers (km^3 for volumes), as morphometric relations are published.
    struct LatticePoint2
    A 2D point as its integer lattice cell and its fraction within the cell.
    struct LatticePoint3
    A 3D point as its integer lattice cell and its fraction within the cell.
    class Layer
    Relief added on top of a source: noise, craters, or a layer of your own.
    struct LayerContext
    How a layer or an albedo is evaluated: where, at what spacing, and on what terrain, as Ground::Context gives it.
    class LayerExposure
    The exposure field a layer may read, at a fixed ground spacing, on the surface it is read on; empty when the layer has none.
    struct LayerTiming
    The time one layer took over every grid.
    struct ListFieldTrait <typename T>
    Whether a field of type T is a list, or an optional list.
    struct ListFieldTrait< std::array< T, N > > <typename T, N>
    struct ListFieldTrait< std::optional< T > > <typename T>
    struct ListFieldTrait< std::vector< T > > <typename T>
    struct LocalFrame
    The east, north and up unit vectors at a surface point.
    class LogPolynomialSfd
    N(>=D) = 10^P(x) / areaUnit with P(x) = sum_i a_i x^i and x = log10(D /diameterUnit ), the form of the Neukum et al.
    struct LogRecord
    One log message.
    class LruCache <typename Key, typename Value, typename Hash>
    A thread-safe cache of recomputable values, holding about capacity units of cost and evicting the least recently used.
    struct ManualBoulder
    A boulder placed by hand: its center and size, and any of its pose and shape fixed; unset fields are drawn as for generated boulders.
    class MartinParkesDunstanProfile
    Simple-crater profile of Martin, Parkes and Dunstan (2014): bowl, inner rim, outer rim and ejecta polynomials joined continuously; degradation rounds the rim.
    class MaskedLayer
    Another layer applied only inside a region, blended back to the unchanged height over feather meters outside it.
    struct MaterialOptions
    How a terrain's material map is made from its shape and layers.
    class MaterialSource
    A layer that lays a material over the surface beneath it, such as sand from dunes.
    struct MeshMaterial
    A mesh's material: a name and a diffuse color.
    struct MeshSize
    The number of vertices and triangles of a mesh.
    struct MidpointRoughness
    The displacement scale and fractal dimension a raster's heights show.
    class MinimumField
    The smaller of two fields at each point, the one that has a value where the other is NaN: a completeness limit that two limits give, such as a catalog's and a DEM's ( SourceResolvedLimit ).
    class MinimumSfd
    The pointwise minimum of distributions of one kind, such as the DSNE crater density: the lesser of the production surface and the equilibrium density at every diameter.
    class NoDegradation
    Every crater stays as fresh makes it, optionally with one depth/diameter ratio for all.
    class NoiseLayer
    A stack of fractals added to the terrain, rolling relief on a flat source or detail on a DEM, measured from the context's ReferencePoint .
    struct NoiseLayerKernel
    The enabled fractals of a noise layer, in order.
    struct NoiseLayerOptions
    The noise a NoiseLayer adds: its stack of fractals and what of it a source already holds.
    struct ObliqueImpacts
    How oblique impacts shape a crater's rays.
    class PavementLayer
    Fractured bedrock pavement added to the terrain: Voronoi plates, each flat with its own tilt and height step, parted by cracks (or ridges) with rounded shoulders, and split again by finer octaves of cracks that end at the cracks before them; each octave fades out where too fine for the spacing.
    struct PavementOptions
    The plates and cracks of a PavementLayer . Lengths are in meters, angles in degrees.
    class PiecewisePowerLawSfd
    A cumulative distribution of power-law segments, each applying from its start to the next.
    class PiecewiseUniformSfd
    A distribution of diameter bands, each holding features per m^2 with diameters uniform across it; overlapping bands add.
    struct PixelWindow
    A block of a raster's cells: columns [ colBegin ,colEnd ) and rows [rowBegin ,rowEnd ).
    class PlanarCells
    Square cells on a plane: cell (i, j) of side L covers [i L, (i + 1) L) x [j L, (j + 1) L).
    struct Plane
    The plane h = a +b dx +c dy, dx and dy in meters east and north of a reference point.
    class PlaneFit
    A least-squares plane h = a + b dx + c dy through points added one at a time.
    class PostLattice
    The posts of a source: heights on a regular lattice, such as a DEM's cells or noise sampled at a fixed spacing.
    struct PowerLawDiffusivity
    A diffusivity kappa = coefficient (D / 1 km)^exponent m^2/Myr, held at its value atminDiameter below it; usable as aDiffusionAgeModel .
    struct PowerLawSegment
    A power law N(>=D) = coefficient * D^(-exponent ) fromstart meters, alone or as one segment of aPiecewisePowerLawSfd .
    class PowerLawSfd
    N(>=D) = coefficient * D^(-exponent ), with D in meters and N per m^2 (or per m^2 per Gyr).
    struct PowerLawSpectrum
    A power-law spectrum P(f) = C f^-beta, by its slope and the RMS height it holds in the octave of wavelengths just finer than the base's Nyquist wavelength.
    struct PreparedCrater
    A crater ready to shape at one sample spacing.
    struct PreparedReuse
    Whose outlines and states PrepareCraters may reuse from those a thread prepared before: anEvaluationCache::Id and the layer that owns the craters; a zerocache reuses nothing.
    class ProductionSurface
    The cumulative crater density on a surface of a given age: a production function scaled so that N(>=1 km) follows a chronology, N(D, T) = Phi(D) * N1(T) / Phi(1 km).
    class RadialShape
    The radius of a star-shaped body along each direction: the radius at every label of Gaskell's ICQ grid ( LabelDirection ), interpolated bilinearly in equiangular coordinates within each quadrilateral, so it is continuous and stays within the range of the label radii.
    class RandomStream
    A counter-based stream of random numbers built on Philox4x32 .
    class RangeChecker
    Walks the fields of one struct at path , checking each against its range.
    class Raster <typename T>
    A single-band, georeferenced grid of values stored row-major, in cells of its own or in a caller's buffer it borrows.
    class RasterAlbedo
    An albedo map, such as a normal albedo mosaic from orbit, upscaled to the grid: interpolated with method (SampleRaster ), then given sub-cell detail (AlbedoDetail ).
    struct RasterAlbedoOptions
    How a RasterAlbedo interpolates its map and adds detail.
    class RasterField
    A field interpolated from a raster in the surface's coordinates.
    struct RasterFieldOptions
    How a RasterField reads its raster.
    struct RasterGrid
    A grid of cells without values: its size and pixel-to-world transform.
    struct RasterPlacement
    Where a raster that is a window of a larger one, such as a window read from a file, lies in it.
    class RasterPosts
    The posts of a raster that is a window of a larger lattice, such as a window read from a file: posts beyond the larger lattice repeat its edge, and those beyond the window its edge, so reads within the window give the same values as the whole.
    class RasterSource
    Heights from a raster held in memory, in a projected CRS or the surface's coordinates.
    struct RasterSourceOptions
    How a RasterSource reads its raster.
    struct RasterStats
    Summary statistics of a raster's valid cells.
    struct RayDirection
    One ray of a crater.
    struct RayLayout
    How many rays a crater has and how wide they are, after Elliott et al.
    struct RayRetention
    How long a crater keeps its immature, bright material, by diameter, after Werner and Medvedev (2010): smallMyr up tosmallDiameter , a power law of diameter up tomidDiameter ,midMyr up tolargeDiameter andlargeMyr beyond, every time multiplied byscale .
    struct ReflectanceZone
    One reflectance zone around new small craters: a share of craters has it, it changes the reflectance relative to the pre-impact surface by change , and it reachescoefficient D^exponent meters from the center timesscale , both drawn per crater, with a ragged edge of fingers pulled in by up toraggedness of the reach, lastingretentionMyr .
    struct RegionShape
    An area of the surface: a rectangle, a circle or a polygon.
    struct ResolutionFade
    How features too small to resolve at the sample spacing fade out, by the samples across their diameter.
    struct RigidTransform
    A rotation followed by a translation.
    struct RimSmoothing
    How crater rims are rounded: near the rim, the profile is blended toward itself smoothed across distance by a Gaussian, with full weight at the rim fading to none at the band's edges.
    class RockAlbedo
    The albedo brightened by the rock of boulder layers: each band times 1 + share (reflectanceRatio - 1), for the share of each sample rock covers over every layer.
    struct RockAlbedoOptions
    How rocks, brighter than mature regolith (Holt 1981; Clark et al.
    struct RockSource
    A boulder layer whose rock brightens the albedo, and the ground beneath it.
    class RoughnessLayer
    Fine roughness: octaves of Perlin noise from maxWavelength tominWavelength , amplitudes growing as wavelength^H and scaled tormsSlope overbaseline ; unresolved octaves fade.
    struct RoughnessOptions
    The roughness a RoughnessLayer adds: RMS slope over a baseline and Hurst exponent, as Shepard et al.
    class SampleBlock
    Heights and where they are: every cell of a raster, sampled at its center, or a list of scattered points such as wheel contacts.
    class SandFillLayer
    Sand pooled in the lows of the ground beneath it, filling fill of the depth below the mean height on two rings, up tomaxThickness ; it lays sand over the material map.
    struct SandFillOptions
    How much sand a SandFillLayer pools, and where.
    class SandShadowLayer
    Sand shadows: a pyramidal sand tail in the lee of each boulder of a boulder layer, as wide as the boulder and lengthRatio widths long (Hesp 1981); place it after the boulder layer.
    struct SandShadowOptions
    The sand shadows a SandShadowLayer lays behind boulders. Angles are in degrees.
    class ScaleLayer
    Scales and shifts the heights so far: height * scale +offset .
    struct SceneMesh
    A mesh with optional normals and its material.
    struct SceneNode
    An instance of a scene mesh: its vertices scaled per axis by scale , then moved bypose , as glTF composes a node's scale, rotation and translation.
    class SecondaryCraterLayer
    Secondary craters around the craters of a CraterLayer , applied additively withApplyCraters .
    struct SecondaryCraterOptions
    Which primaries throw secondaries, how many, and over what sizes.
    class SecondaryDensity
    The density of the secondaries one primary throws, on average, as SecondaryCraterLayer draws them: rings of n(R) (d / (countFraction D))^-sizeSlope below the largest secondary at each range, gathered into rays when they are on.
    struct SecondaryOutline
    The ellipse an elongated secondary is stretched to.
    struct SecondaryRayField
    Where a primary's secondaries gather: its rays and the clumps along them, as a density over the even spread's.
    struct SecondaryRays
    Secondaries gathered into their primary's rays and clumped along them (Singer et al.
    struct SecondaryShapes
    Secondaries stretched toward their primary, elliptical along the line back to it and rounder with range, as distant secondaries are (Singer et al.
    struct SelectionKeys
    The keys of a crater selection's fields.
    struct SfdJoins
    How the pieces of a distribution must meet at their joins.
    struct SfdPiece
    One piece of a SplicedSfd :distribution applies fromstart meters up to the next piece's start.
    struct ShadedMesh
    A mesh with per-vertex normals, its vertices split along creases so fracture faces keep hard edges while noisy surfaces stay smooth.
    class ShapeModelSource
    The heights a shape model's labels give when an upsampler refines them, over the body made from it ( Surface::ShapeModel ), whose radius interpolates the same labels bilinearly.
    class SizeFrequencyDistribution
    A cumulative size-frequency distribution N(>=D) of craters or boulders.
    struct SizeSlopeMap
    A map of how steeply feature counts fall with size, such as a mean boulder diameter map.
    class SlopeAlbedo
    The albedo of steep ground moved toward fresher material: slopes are read on the ground at the nodes of a lattice baseline meters apart, fixed to the surface, and interpolated between them, so grids, tiles and points agree.
    struct SlopeAlbedoOptions
    How steep ground stays immature as regolith moves downslope (Ikeda et al.
    struct SlopeStats
    Slope statistics of a raster of heights, in degrees.
    class Source
    Where a terrain's heights come from: a DEM, synthetic noise, or your own.
    class SourceChain
    Sources tried in order, each filling where those before it have no data, such as a site DEM over a regional one or a DEM over a flat datum.
    class Span <typename T>
    A view of size() contiguousT s owned elsewhere;T may be const.
    struct SpecName <typename Spec>
    The "type" of the variant alternative Spec (kName ) and what it is (kDescription ).
    class SpectralContinuationLayer
    Detail finer than a base DEM that continues its power-law spectrum with random phases (Saupe 1988), as sparse Gabor noise (Lagae et al.
    struct SpectralContinuationOptions
    The spectrum a SpectralContinuationLayer continues and the wavelengths it adds.
    struct SpectrumFitBand
    The wavelengths, in pixels of the base, over which its spectrum is fitted.
    class SplicedSfd
    A cumulative distribution made of other distributions over consecutive diameter intervals, such as a production function extended below its fitted range by a power law.
    struct SplitPoint
    A sample's coordinates (m), each a float and the float of its remainder ( SplitDifference ): east and north on a plane, or its position (Surface::Position ) on a body.
    struct Splotch
    One splotch.
    class SplotchAlbedo
    The splotches of SplotchAlbedoOptions on the context's surface, darkening and brightening the albedo; the same in any grid, tile or point.
    struct SplotchAlbedoOptions
    Splotches after Speyerer et al.
    struct SplotchSwarms
    Swarms of splotches thrown by new craters, the low-velocity secondaries of their ejecta (Robinson et al.
    class SteadyStateAges
    Ages of craters on a surface ageGyr old where small craters are in equilibrium.
    class Stopwatch
    Measures elapsed wall-clock time from construction, for timing log messages.
    class StrataLayer
    Layered rock: the ground beneath terraced into dipping beds, each a bench below a cliff, so hills become buttes and mesas; it lays bedrock over the material map on the cliffs.
    struct StrataOptions
    The beds a StrataLayer cuts. Lengths are in meters, angles in degrees.
    class SummedSfd
    The sum of weighted distributions of one kind, N(>=D) = sum of weight * N_i(>=D), such as boulders between craters plus the blocks thrown out by them.
    class Surface
    The plane or body a terrain lies on, measuring distances and directions between surface coordinates: meters on a plane, planetocentric longitude and latitude in degrees on a body.
    class SurfaceCells
    Partitions a surface into cells so features can be generated per cell, each from its own random substream, identically however a region is tiled.
    class SurfaceField
    A scalar quantity over a surface, read at surface coordinates: meters on a plane, longitude and latitude in degrees on a sphere.
    class SyntheticAlbedo
    An albedo for terrain without data: a base color with noise in each channel, the saturation and value clamped to [0, 1] after it.
    struct SyntheticAlbedoOptions
    The color of a SyntheticAlbedo : a base color in hue, saturation and value, each varied by a stack of fractals (EvaluateFractals , with amplitudes in the channel's units).
    class SyntheticSource
    Heights generated rather than loaded: elevation plus a stack of fractals (FractalStackAt , measured from the origin on a plane, in 3D on a body), with no bounds.
    class TabulatedSfd
    A cumulative distribution given as a table of (D, N(>=D)) points, interpolated linearly in log D and log N, so each interval is a power law.
    class Terrain
    A surface, a source (0 m without one) and layers applied in order.
    struct TerrainBase
    The surface and source, the same as their Terrain 's, that crater, secondary crater and boulder layers derive their cells, caches and completeness from when built.
    class TerrainGenConfig
    A terrain configuration: the body, source, layers, outputs, albedo and materials its JSON describes ( ParseConfig ,LoadConfig ), held as an immutable value that is cheap to copy.
    struct TerrainReport
    A generated terrain's report: its grids' statistics, layer timings and how it was run.
    class TerrainView
    The heights of a terrain over one grid, for loops that edit the terrain and evaluate it again.
    struct TriangleMesh
    A triangle mesh of shared vertices; triangles are counter-clockwise seen from outside.
    struct U32x2
    Two 32-bit words: a Philox key.
    struct U32x4
    Four 32-bit words: a Philox counter or output block.
    struct UVec3
    Three 32-bit words.
    class UniformAges
    Ages uniform over one lifetime for every diameter, so freshness is uniform in [0, 1].
    struct UniformBand
    One band of a piecewise uniform distribution: density features with diameters spread uniformly over [min ,max ) meters.
    struct UnresolvedCover
    The share of a sample's area covered by boulders too small to resolve in it.
    class Upsampler
    How a source's posts become heights at any point and at any sample spacing in the posts' units: interpolation, or refinement that adds detail as the spacing shrinks.
    struct ValueDistribution
    A distribution a parameter is drawn from, clamped to [ min ,max ].
    struct ValueRange
    An interval to draw a value uniformly from.
    struct Vec2d
    A 2D point or offset in double precision.
    struct Vec3d
    A 3D point or vector in double precision.
    struct WarpOffset2
    A 2D domain warp offset.
    struct WarpOffset3
    A 3D domain warp offset.
    struct WeightedSfd
    One term of a SummedSfd :distribution scaled byweight .
    struct WorleyDistances
    Distances from a point to its nearest and second-nearest feature points, and the random value of the nearest point's Voronoi cell.
    struct ZoneShadows
    Topographic shadows in the distal reflectance zones (Speyerer et al.

    Floats of a crater's central peak in CraterData before its massifs: the ridged roughness over the peak's height, its wavelength and the warp of the massifs' outlines in peak base radii, the noise's hash key, and the massifs' height and width over the profile's peak.
    const uint32_t kPeakMassifValues = 11u
    Floats of each massif of a central peak, after the header: its center east and north and its radius in peak base radii, the square root of its aspect ratio, the cosine and sine of its long axis's heading, its height over the peak's, the exponent of its flanks, and its summit's offset east and north within its footprint, and the power of its flanks.

    How far a central peak's massifs reach, warp included, in peak base radii.
    const float kTableFineFade = 6.5f
    The power of the share a rim table keeps of its fine rest, past the harmonics it carries: half the order of the first harmonic past them (13), as harmonic k keeps share ^(k / 2).
    const float kTerraceBlockBlend = 0.3f
    Share of a scallop's arc on each side of a cusp over which neighboring blocks' values blend.
    const uint32_t kTerraceHeader = 20u
    Floats of a crater's terraces in CraterData before its scarps: the floor edge in radii, the bench's share of the wall's slope, the strength, the scarps' rounding share, the arcs' cut and width, (amplitude, phase) pairs of harmonics 2 to 6 of the arcs, and the rim crest's scallop height in radii, number and phase, and the share of slump blocks missing from the benches.
    const uint32_t kTerraceScarpValues = 8u
    Floats of each scarp of a crater's terraces after the header: mean position across the wall (0 floor edge, 1 rim crest), scallop height, scallop count and phase, wobble amplitude and phase, and each scallop block's step and hash key.
    const uint32_t kTerraceStepValues = 3u
    Floats of each step of a crater's terraces, after its scarps: its bench level, its scarp share and how much of its bench it keeps, less on walls too steep for one.

    Most fractals a stack may hold; a fixed bound keeps stacks uploadable to GPUs. 

    const uint32_t terraingen::kMaxFractals;

    variable kNoiseBasisCount¶

    Number of NoiseBasis values. 

    const uint32_t terraingen::kNoiseBasisCount;

    variable kPeakHeader¶

    Floats of a crater's central peak in CraterData before its massifs: the ridged roughness over the peak's height, its wavelength and the warp of the massifs' outlines in peak base radii, the noise's hash key, and the massifs' height and width over the profile's peak. 

    const uint32_t terraingen::kPeakHeader;

    variable kPeakMassifValues¶

    Floats of each massif of a central peak, after the header: its center east and north and its radius in peak base radii, the square root of its aspect ratio, the cosine and sine of its long axis's heading, its height over the peak's, the exponent of its flanks, and its summit's offset east and north within its footprint, and the power of its flanks. 

    const uint32_t terraingen::kPeakMassifValues;

    variable kPeakReach¶

    How far a central peak's massifs reach, warp included, in peak base radii. 

    const float terraingen::kPeakReach;

    variable kTableFineFade¶

    The power of the share a rim table keeps of its fine rest, past the harmonics it carries: half the order of the first harmonic past them (13), as harmonic k keeps share ^(k / 2). 

    const float terraingen::kTableFineFade;

    A smoothing choice so fine rim roughness stays near the crest, not a measured value.

    variable kTerraceBlockBlend¶

    Share of a scallop's arc on each side of a cusp over which neighboring blocks' values blend. 

    const float terraingen::kTerraceBlockBlend;

    variable kTerraceHeader¶

    Floats of a crater's terraces in CraterData before its scarps: the floor edge in radii, the bench's share of the wall's slope, the strength, the scarps' rounding share, the arcs' cut and width, (amplitude, phase) pairs of harmonics 2 to 6 of the arcs, and the rim crest's scallop height in radii, number and phase, and the share of slump blocks missing from the benches. 

    const uint32_t terraingen::kTerraceHeader;

    variable kTerraceScarpValues¶

    Floats of each scarp of a crater's terraces after the header: mean position across the wall (0 floor edge, 1 rim crest), scallop height, scallop count and phase, wobble amplitude and phase, and each scallop block's step and hash key. 

    const uint32_t terraingen::kTerraceScarpValues;

    variable kTerraceStepValues¶

    Floats of each step of a crater's terraces, after its scarps: its bench level, its scarp share and how much of its bench it keeps, less on walls too steep for one. 

    const uint32_t terraingen::kTerraceStepValues;

    function DefaultBoulderStyles¶

    The default mix of boulder styles, every one cut irregularly, weathered at its edges and rough on its faces: polyhedra from a sphere (angular, platy, subrounded) most of all, then blocks from a cube, wedges, pyramids, rounded boulders, shards from a tetrahedron and near-spheres.

    function DefaultCraterModels¶

    The crater models a configuration's crater layer has by default: a 3.5 Gyr extended Neukum production surface capped by Hartmann equilibrium (Fassett 2022, https://doi.org/10.1029/2022JE007510 ), steady-state ages on it, Martin-Parkes-Dunstan profiles, and diffusion matched to the ages from the lunar fresh morphometry.

    function EstimateMidpointRoughness¶

    The roughness of heights on its own cells, by medians so that a few large features such as craters do not set it: the scale isEstimateMidpointScale , and the fractal dimension 3 - H from the median absolute height differences at lags of 1, 2, 4 and 8 cells; a raster without relief gives a scale of 0 and dimension 2.5.

    function EstimateMidpointScale¶

    The displacement scale Se of heights on its own cells, robust to a few large features: the median absolute difference of each cell and the mean of its four neighbors, times 1.4826 so that Gaussian relief gives its RMS; 0 without such a cell. 

    double terraingen::EstimateMidpointScale (
    const Raster < float > & heights
)

    function Fassett2022HartmannDiffusivity¶

    Fassett et al. 

    PowerLawDiffusivity terraingen::Fassett2022HartmannDiffusivity ()

    's (2022) diffusivity holding the Hartmann equilibrium, kappa = 3.6 D^0.87 m^2/Myr with D in km, held at its 5 m value below 5 m. Pair it with steady-state ages on the Hartmann equilibrium; with Trask's it wears craters far too fast.

    function FillMesh¶

    Writes the mesh BuildMesh makes ofheights into caller buffers, bit for bit:positions as x, y, z triples andtriangles as vertex index triples, inBuildMesh 's order. 

    void terraingen::FillMesh (
    const Raster < float > & heights,
    Span < double > positions,
    Span < std::int32_t > triangles,
    const Surface & surface={},
    const Vec2d & site={},
    const BuildMeshOptions & options={}
)

    The layout matches an array of Chrono's ChVector3d and ChVector3i, or NumPy arrays of shape (N, 3) float64 and (M, 3) int32, so callers resize those to GetMeshSize and pass their data with no copy.

    Parameters:

    • positions 3 * GetMeshSize(heights, options).vertices doubles, in meters.
    • triangles 3 * GetMeshSize(heights, options).triangles indices into the vertices.
    • site Surface coordinates of the site; unused on a plane.

    Exception:

    • std::invalid_argument as GetMeshSize, for a buffer of another size, or for a mesh of more than INT32_MAX vertices.

    function GaleVentifacts¶

    The ventifacts of Gale crater's Bradbury Landing to Rocknest traverse: half the rocks are ventifacts and 78% of those faceted, 39% faceted in all, 12 of the 39 faceted with keels (Bridges et al. 

    BoulderVentifacts terraingen::GaleVentifacts ()

    2014), and facets of 50 to 60 deg as on basalt (Laity and Bridges 2009). The winds are left to the site: Gale's came from the southwest and north-northeast.

    function KernelOutlineScaleAt¶

    function MarsBarchans¶

    Martian barchans with large ripples: 29 deg slip faces, 8 deg stoss slopes, 370 m wide, domes below 200 m wide and twice as long as wide; spacing and density are placeholders to set per site. 

    DuneOptions terraingen::MarsBarchans ()

    function MarsComplexCraterShape¶

    The floor diameter, peak height and peak diameter fits of fresh Martian complex craters for ComplexCraterProfile , fromkMarsComplexCraterDiameter , with peak fits held at 100 km beyond and the lunar floor fit. 

    ComplexCraterShape terraingen::MarsComplexCraterShape ()

    function MarsDesiccationRidges¶

    The desiccation ridges of the Old Soaker slab in Gale crater (Stein et al. 

    PavementOptions terraingen::MarsDesiccationRidges ()

    2018): 2 cm polygons parted by 5 mm high ridges about 2 mm wide (from ridges covering about 20 % of the slab), flat and untilted. The polygons there are mostly four-sided with T-junctions; Voronoi plates meet at Y-junctions.

    function MarsDuneGrainflows¶

    The grainflows of Namib Dune's lee slope (Ewing et al. 

    DuneGrainflows terraingen::MarsDuneGrainflows ()

    2017, Table 1): scarps 0.54 to 0.67 m wide and 1.0 to 1.6 m long, lobes 0.57 to 0.66 m wide and 2.9 to 6 m long. Their thickness is not measured on Mars; 0.015 m is that of a Namibian barchan's grainflows (Nield et al. 2017, in Ewing et al. 2017). Every cell holds one, as palimpsest grainflows are abundant on that slope.

    function MarsDuneRipples¶

    Martian large wind ripples to lay on dunes: 2.1 m wavelength, 0.2 m height and a 30 deg lee; 0.099 pairs of crest ends per meter, as Olympia Undae's 2.1 m wind ripples (Ewing et al. 

    DuneRipples terraingen::MarsDuneRipples ()

    2010); sinuous on stoss slopes and straighter on flanks and lee slopes (Lapotre et al. 2016; Ewing et al. 2017).

    function MarsFreshCraterMorphometry¶

    Depth and rim height over diameter of a fresh Martian crater: at most 0.23 and 0.03, falling to Garvin et al. 

    CraterMorphometry terraingen::MarsFreshCraterMorphometry (

)

    • diameter In meters.

    2006a, b; Fernando et al. 2013).

    function PlaceBoulderModel¶

    The placement of a shape as a boulder standing on the ground. 

    BoulderPlacement terraingen::PlaceBoulderModel (
    const Boulder & boulder,
    const BoulderShape & shape,
    double groundHeight,
    bool settle=true
)

    The long axis is scaled to the diameter (the intermediate in proportion) and the short axis to the height; then stood on the axis rest names, leaned by lean about the long axis, turned by yaw, tipped by tilt toward tiltAzimuth, and set at the boulder's position with burial of its vertical extent below groundHeight. With settle, before the tilt it is tipped over on level ground, from that pose, until it rests stably with its center of mass above the face or edges it stands on, so no shape is left balanced on a corner.

    Parameters:

    • groundHeight Height of the ground under its center, in meters.

The depth is depth_m, else depth_ratio times the diameter, which a list written with attributes holds as realized, and with a depth the rim height is rim_height_m, else rim_height; so craters read back from such a list are shaped as listed whatever the models.     const CraterFeatures * craters,
    const BoulderFeatures * boulders,
    const SizeFrequencyDistribution * craterTarget,
    unsigned threads=0
)

    Slopes come from central differences (one-sided at edges and beside no-data cells) of the heights against the east and north offsets in meters between cell centers on surface; cells without data, or without a neighbor with data along a grid axis, are skipped.

    Parameters:

    • craters The craters listed over the grid, or null.
    • boulders The boulders listed over the grid, or null.
    • craterTarget The crater density the bins' expected counts come from, or null.
    • threads Threads for the slopes; 0 for every hardware thread. The result does not depend on it.

    function WriteBoulderList¶

    Writes boulders as CSV (columns x, y, ground, diameter, height, burial, yaw_deg, lean_deg, id, model, wear, parent, piece, rest, tilt_deg and tilt_azimuth_deg, angles in degrees) or as JSON ({"boulders": [...]}) with the same keys, doubles written exactly and an unknown ground left empty (CSV) or null (JSON). 

    void terraingen::WriteBoulderList (
    const BoulderList & boulders,
    const std::filesystem::path & path,
    ListFormat format
)

    Exception:

    • std::runtime_error if the file cannot be written.

    function WriteBoulderModels¶

    Writes boulder models as a scene ( WriteScene ): each shape once with crease normals and its material, drawn once per boulder (glTF), one object per boulder (OBJ) or one merged mesh (STL). 

    void terraingen::WriteBoulderModels (
    const std::vector< BoulderModel > & boulders,
    const std::filesystem::path & path,
    double creaseAngle=60.0,
    const Surface & surface={},
    const Vec2d & site={},
    bool instanced=true
)

    On a sphere the world is the east-north-up frame of site on the datum sphere (PlacementAtSite), so coordinates stay small; WriteOutputs uses the grid's center.

    Parameters:

    • creaseAngle Angle in degrees, from 0 to 180, above which normals are split.
    • instanced Whether shared shapes are written once and drawn per boulder; otherwise each boulder is written as its own mesh, already placed, for tools without instancing.

    Exception:

    • std::invalid_argument for no boulders, an angle outside [0, 180] or as WriteScene.
    • std::runtime_error if the file cannot be written.

    function WriteCraterList¶

    Writes craters as CSV (columns x, y, diameter, age_gyr, id, manual, replace) or as JSON ({"craters": [{"x": ..., "y": ..., ...}]}), with doubles written exactly. 

    void terraingen::WriteCraterList (
    const CraterList & craters,
    const std::filesystem::path & path,
    ListFormat format,
    const std::vector< CraterAttributes > & attributes={}
)

    With an attributes entry for every crater, each also gets floor_depth, rim_height, depth_ratio, freshness and complex.

    Exception:

    • std::invalid_argument for attributes that are neither empty nor one per crater.
    • std::runtime_error if the file cannot be written.

    function WriteGeoTiff¶

    Writes a raster as a tiled, little-endian float32 GeoTIFF with its transform and its no-data value as GDAL_NODATA, edge tiles padded with the no-data value or 0. 

    void terraingen::WriteGeoTiff (
    const std::filesystem::path & path,
    const Raster < float > & raster,
    const GeoKeys & geoKeys={},
    const GeoTiffWriteOptions & options={}
)

    Parameters:

    • geoKeys The projection keys, as ReadGeoTiff returned them.

    Exception:

    function WriteGeoTiff¶

    Writes rasters as one GeoTIFF of as many float32 bands. 

    void terraingen::WriteGeoTiff (
    const std::filesystem::path & path,
    const std::vector< Raster < float > > & bands,
    const GeoKeys & geoKeys={},
    const GeoTiffWriteOptions & options={}
)

    Several bands are stored band after band (planar configuration 2), with the first band's transform and no-data value; otherwise as WriteGeoTiff for one raster.

    Parameters:

    • bands The bands; at least one, all on one grid.

    Exception:

    • GeoTiffError as for one raster, or for no bands or bands on different grids.
